# IvyPanda

> > IvyPanda is an academic support platform offering homework help, essay examples, test preparation guides, and language learning resources for students.

IvyPanda provides comprehensive educational resources including TOEFL/IELTS exam preparation, research grant guidance, mental health support for students, and extensive collections of essay examples across various lengths. The platform also features unique language learning tools like multilingual tongue twisters and emergency essay writing services for students facing tight deadlines.

## Key Topics

- Academic Writing
- Essay Examples
- TOEFL Preparation
- English Proficiency Testing
- Research Papers
- Exam Strategy
- Language Learning
- Pronunciation Practice
- Student Mental Health
- Research Grants
- SAT/ACT Preparation
- IELTS vs PTE
- Homework Help
- Test Preparation
- Nontraditional Students

## Student Support & Resources

- [220 Mental Health Resources for Students [Free & Affordable]](https://ivypanda.com/blog/mental-health-resources): Comprehensive list of 220 free and affordable mental health resources for students

- [Going to College as an Older Student](https://ivypanda.com/blog/older-students-in-college): Guide for nontraditional adult students returning to college education
- [i have an essay due tomorrow and i haven't started . net](https://ivypanda.com/blog/i-have-an-essay-due-tomorrow-and-i-havent-started): IvyPanda's emergency essay writing service for last-minute deadlines

- [TOEFL Study Plan & Tips [How to Prepare for TOEFL in 10 Days?]](https://ivypanda.com/blog/how-to-prepare-for-toefl): TOEFL iBT preparation guide with 10-day study plan and test-taking tips
- [PTE vs. IELTS Comparison: Which Exam to Take?](https://ivypanda.com/blog/pte-vs-ielts-comparison): Comparison guide for choosing between PTE and IELTS English proficiency exams
- [Top 52 Free Online Tests to Check your Knowledge](https://ivypanda.com/blog/free-online-tests): Curated list of 52 free online test platforms for ACT, SAT & exam prep
